functional_requirements: Display a tourbillon escapement mechanism at approximately 100×100×100 mm scale suitable for 3D printing
Show the rotating cage carrying the escape wheel, balance wheel, lever, and hairspring
Mount on a solid base plate with a central fixed fourth wheel
Produce individual STL files per part plus a combined assembly STEP for reference
unknowns: Optimal print orientation and support strategy per part
Tolerances for press-fit assembly (nominal 0.3 mm clearance recommended)
assumptions: Each part is printed separately; the assembly STEP shows the intended relative positions
The cage is a static display element (not a functional rotating bearing)
All parts use the approved Mechanism DSL tourbillon operations
